sources.title: Snipe-IT Asset Tags
sources.released_version_or_commit: Live documentation; no product release is declared on this page.
sources.locator: Asset Tags; uniqueness, auto-increment, prefix and length settings.
sources.observed_operation: The documentation says asset tags uniquely identify assets within Snipe-IT and describes optional auto-incrementing/prefix behavior.
sources.conditions_defaults_exceptions: Auto-increment can be enabled; non-numeric asset tags can confuse the next auto-increment value; length changes do not rewrite existing tags.
sources.applicability: Useful asset-identity pattern; system-specific uniqueness does not itself choose or govern the cooperative namespace.

sources.title: Snipe-IT Asset Labels and Barcodes
sources.released_version_or_commit: Live documentation; page does not bind behavior to a release.
sources.locator: Asset Labels, lines describing 1D/2D output, QR route, USB/Bluetooth scanners and barcode-enable setting.
sources.observed_operation: Selected assets generate labels with a 1D search barcode and a 2D QR that opens the linked system asset page on a mobile QR reader.
sources.conditions_defaults_exceptions: Barcodes must be enabled. The described QR opens the asset record and therefore depends on its host being reachable; the 1D barcode is a separate search path.
sources.applicability: Evidence for separating human/1D staff ID from optional web QR; not evidence of offline record access.

sources.title: Snipe-IT Managing Assets
sources.released_version_or_commit: Live documentation; no product release is declared on this page.
sources.locator: Managing Assets; unique asset tags and Best Practices / checking out assets to non-people.
sources.observed_operation: The manual describes check-in/check-out state and says checking assets out to locations or other assets is possible but discouraged.
sources.conditions_defaults_exceptions: The product recommends an accountable person rather than a location as checkout target.
sources.applicability: Shows a lightweight asset lifecycle and an explicit mismatch for depot-to-depot custody as a default workflow.

sources.title: Snipe-IT issue #19515 — QR Code Text on New Label Engine
sources.released_version_or_commit: Reported on v8.7.1; opened 2026-08-18; closed 2026-09-23 by merge commit c1d1cd1.
sources.locator: Issue description and activity, especially version, migration symptom, linked PR and closing commit.
sources.observed_operation: Reporter said the old QR Code Text field did not carry into the new label engine and could result in no QR payload.
sources.conditions_defaults_exceptions: Reporter identified the new/legacy label-engine switch and Snipe-IT v8.7.1; this is a product configuration migration issue.
sources.applicability: Supports post-migration label-content checks; not a general scanner defect or evidence of cooperative label behavior.

sources.title: Snipe-IT PR #19633 — source change for legacy to new QR title transfer
sources.released_version_or_commit: PR commit 1e0fc8c; merged into develop 2026-09-17; issue closure cites c1d1cd1 merged to master 2026-09-23.
sources.locator: PR summary/activity and changed app/Http/Controllers/SettingsController.php; transition copies qr_code_text into label2_title once.
sources.retrieval_operation: web__run open of PR and Files tab
sources.observed_operation: The diff adds the one-time legacy QR text to new-engine title transfer when enabling the new label engine.
sources.conditions_defaults_exceptions: Change is conditional on switching from the legacy engine to the new engine; this is a settings migration path.
sources.applicability: Relevant source-code and fix-history example. No ancestry check established whether this exact fix is included in v8.8.0; do not claim it is.

sources.title: Snipe-IT v8.8.0 release
sources.observed_operation: A v8.8.0 release exists and is dated after the label-engine PR/issue fix history.
sources.conditions_defaults_exceptions: Release page alone does not establish whether PR #19633 is an ancestor of this tag.
sources.applicability: Version context only; use exact deployed tag and retest labels.

sources.title: Odoo 18 — Process receipts and deliveries with barcodes
sources.locator: Enable Barcode app; Barcode Nomenclature; Scan barcodes for receipts; validate operation.
sources.retrieval_operation: web__run search_query returned page excerpt; later open attempts timed out.
sources.observed_operation: Docs describe real-time receipt work through Barcode app using a scanner or mobile app, selecting an outstanding receipt, scanning products/package and validating.
sources.conditions_defaults_exceptions: Barcode feature must be enabled. Default UPC/EAN nomenclature and GS1 nomenclature are distinct configuration choices; default behavior handles UPC/EAN conversion.
sources.applicability: Workflow comparison evidence from the versioned docs; no app/runtime was operated and offline behavior was not established.

sources.title: Odoo 18 — Operation types and commands
sources.locator: Operation types and commands; Receipts (WHIN), scanning command barcode vs individual scheduled receipt.
sources.retrieval_operation: web__run search_query returned page excerpt; later open attempts timed out.
sources.observed_operation: The generic Receipts operation barcode WHIN creates a new receipt operation; to process a scheduled receipt staff scan/print the barcode for that individual picking.
sources.conditions_defaults_exceptions: A command barcode is not an individual receipt reference; exact workflow depends on the specific operation barcode.
sources.applicability: Strong example for separating receipt-event/operation identity from shipment and crate labels.

sources.title: Odoo 18 — Configure product / packages versus product packaging
sources.locator: Comparison/use cases, especially Packages versus Packagings; Package Use; unique individual package barcode versus type-level packaging barcode.
sources.retrieval_operation: web__run search_query returned page excerpt; later open attempt timed out.
sources.observed_operation: The docs distinguish tracked physical packages with contents and individual barcodes, configurable reusable/disposable, from product-specific fixed quantity packaging whose barcode denotes the type.
sources.conditions_defaults_exceptions: Package and packaging are different objects. A package barcode is unique to an individual physical package; packaging labels can repeat for identical groupings.
sources.applicability: Direct alternative model for reusable crate records; the cooperative still must test actual fit and label formats.

sources.title: Sortly — Can I use Sortly in offline mode?
sources.locator: Offline mode availability, Disable Sync steps, FAQ on local updates and pre-offline full sync.
sources.observed_operation: Mobile iOS/Android only; disabling sync permits local inventory-level updates; changes are pushed after sync is restored; device works from the snapshot present when sync was disabled.
sources.conditions_defaults_exceptions: Offline mode is not available on the web app; vendor advises a full sync before disabling sync.
sources.applicability: Useful offline comparator but not proof of event-level multi-depot queue, conflict control, or idempotent receipt replay.

sources.title: Sortly — What kind of scanners can I use?
sources.locator: Mobile camera, Bluetooth scanner, web capabilities, plan availability and QR scanner FAQ.
sources.observed_operation: Built-in phone camera scans QR/barcodes; web scans can search/link but not check-in/out; 1D scanner cannot read QR and QR needs a 2D-capable scanner.
sources.conditions_defaults_exceptions: Bluetooth integration is limited to Ultra, Premium and Enterprise tiers; supported hardware/operating systems vary by path.
sources.applicability: Concrete camera/low-cost and 2D/1D tradeoff; app behavior not tested.

sources.title: GS1 General Specifications release 26.0 — GRAI
sources.locator: Section 2.3.1, Global Returnable Asset Identifier (GRAI): AI (8003), printed page 141.
sources.retrieval_operation: web__run search_query returned the complete section excerpt; direct open was unavailable in this web tool.
sources.observed_operation: The section defines GRAI for returnable assets including crates; asset type can be shared by identical assets and optional serial distinguishes individuals; AI 8003 must not identify carried trade items; carriers include GS1-128, GS1 DataMatrix and GS1 QR Code.
sources.conditions_defaults_exceptions: GRAI includes the assigning company's GS1 Company Prefix; optional serial distinguishes individual assets. The source is a GS1 member-organization copy of the ratified standard.
sources.applicability: Very close global analogue, but no prefix purchase/GS1 allocation is authorized in this pilot.

sources.title: GS1 Digital Link Standard — URI Syntax 1.7.0
sources.locator: Primary key AI 8003 / GRAI; §6 Recognising a GS1 Digital Link URI; phone URL decoding; change log.
sources.observed_operation: GRAI appears as primary AI 8003. The spec describes Digital Link as a Web URI and says a general-purpose scanner app can treat it like any other URL; QR/Data Matrix URI can be read by phone camera/browser or dedicated app.
sources.conditions_defaults_exceptions: URI recognition is plausibility detection, not proof of full conformance; path/domain may vary and resolver compatibility is separate.
sources.applicability: Supports optional web-link decoding path and GRAI URL analogy; does not make a normal QR a verified receipt.

sources.title: GS1-Conformant Resolver Standard
sources.released_version_or_commit: Current at access: Release 1.2.1, ratified Aug 2026.
sources.locator: §2.2 core functionality; §§2.5.8–2.6 redirection; §2.12 query strings; §9.3 change log; 1.2.1 erratum.
sources.observed_operation: Resolver supports default and requested link-type behavior, returning 404 for unavailable requested types. Current log says 1.2.1 corrected the serial qualifier AI from 17 to 21 in §2.5.10. Query key/value pairs are passed through by default.
sources.conditions_defaults_exceptions: The AI correction concerns GTIN hierarchy serial parsing, not GRAI AI 8003. A missing requested link type returns 404 rather than falling back to default under current rules.
sources.applicability: Redirect governance and parser-version example for a future GS1 option; web owner must own target updates and tests.

sources.title: GS1 Barcode Syntax Engine source and release 1.4.1
sources.released_version_or_commit: Release 1.4.1, commit ec595ff, released May 28, 2026; repository provides source in C/C++ and language bindings.
sources.locator: Release notes: long Digital Link stem overflow fix; source repository README/JS-WASM example and source architecture.
sources.observed_operation: GS1 repository describes a syntax engine processing AI element strings, GS1 Digital Link URIs, and normalized scanner data; release 1.4.1 fixes overflow on very long Digital Link URI stems.
sources.conditions_defaults_exceptions: Source code/excerpts are read-only; the library is not installed, executed, or validated here. Later main-branch changes are not attributed to release 1.4.1.
sources.applicability: Useful future parser candidate if a GS1 path is selected; keep printed URLs short and pin tested version.

sources.title: GS1 System Architecture — Digital Link 2D symbol decoding
sources.released_version_or_commit: Live architecture page; no immutable version shown.
sources.locator: Decoding process for a 2D Symbol (GS1 Digital Link URI), lines on QR/Data Matrix and smartphone camera/browser, URI checks, link types and resolver.
sources.observed_operation: Architecture describes QR/Data Matrix carrying a URL-like GS1 URI; native smartphone camera, browser, generic scanning app, or dedicated app can scan it, followed by HTTP(S) link/resolver behavior.
sources.conditions_defaults_exceptions: A general decoder extracts the URL; recognition as a conformant GS1 Digital Link and successful resolver access are later separate steps.
sources.applicability: Supports alternative scan paths and separates decode success from resolution and receipt confirmation.

sources.title: Snipe-IT Barcodes manual, v8.3.6
sources.released_version_or_commit: Documentation explicitly for Snipe-IT v8.3.6; page points to latest docs v8.8.0.
sources.locator: Changing your URL; supported 1D formats; QR Codes; legacy/new label engine note.
sources.observed_operation: After APP_URL changes, the manual says to clear config cache and generated barcode image cache so QR images are regenerated with the new URL. It also says QR opens the asset detail page and barcode generation fails when a tag does not satisfy a selected 1D symbology.
sources.conditions_defaults_exceptions: This is v8.3.6 documentation, not a statement verified for later deployed tags. C128 accepts alphanumeric/numeric payloads; UPC/EAN formats impose narrower patterns.
sources.applicability: Historical versioned behavior showing URL/label coupling and label format constraints; verify exact behavior on any selected current release.

method_notes: Research began from the exact assigned brief after native Goal activation. The unreleased plan was not accessed during discovery.
Some Odoo/GS1 sources were returned as search-indexed primary-source excerpts; the source record states when a later direct open timed out or was unavailable.
No product runtime, account, scanner, label, resolver, downloaded executable, install, or local discriminating check was used.
